newsitem.title: UK: Medeva shares climb as profits top forecast.
newsitem.headline: Medeva shares climb as profits top forecast.

text.p: Shares in Medeva Plc climbed on Wednesday after the British drugs group reported higher-than-expected annual profits.
The shares jumped to 293p before settling back to 284-1/2, up 4-1/2p, by 0932 GMT.
Medeva reported underlying pre-tax profits of 103.5 million stg, compared with analysts' forecasts of around 101 million. The total dividend was in line with expectations at 4.8p per share.
"The figures were good and the whole sector is strong today," one market-maker said.
